title: Indifferentiable Construction Below Rate 3
summary: The source identifies rate 3 as the achieved benchmark and leaves open whether an indifferentiable construction can improve on that efficiency.

scope.domain: Symmetric cryptography, focusing on indifferentiable authenticated-encryption constructions and their efficiency.
parameters: rate r, measuring the construction's primitive-call efficiency
scope.unresolved_remainder: Whether an indifferentiable construction with rate strictly below 3 exists.

progress.summary: The paper presents rate 3 as an achieved benchmark and explicitly asks whether an indifferentiable construction with a lower rate is achievable.
